svg.desc: Temperatures at 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4 minutes are 80, 62, 48, 38 and 31 degrees Celsius. Dotted segments connect samples for reading only; no differential equation or fitted cooling law is asserted.
svg.title: Five synthetic temperature observations
